draft.summary: Limit coupons to one use per customer account
draft.description:
## Context
Type: Story (created as Task; this Jira project has no Story type).

Proposed owner (from the meeting): Andrés Gil.

Phase: 1.

The weekend promo starts Saturday. The team already decided that coupons are one use per customer; this meeting defined what one use means and what customers see.

## User Story
As the bakery, I want each coupon limited to one use per customer account, so that the promotion follows the one-use-per-customer decision.

## Acceptance Criteria
- AC1: **Coupon used for the first time** (Happy path) — A signed-in customer applies a coupon their account has not used. Expected: the discount is applied to the cart.
- AC2: **Coupon already used on the account** (Negative case) — A signed-in customer applies a coupon their account already used, from any device. Expected: no discount is applied and the message "This coupon was already used on your account." is shown, without an error code.
- AC3: **Guest checkout** (Negative case) — A customer without an account tries to apply a coupon. Expected: the coupon is not applied and the customer is asked to sign in.

## Business Rules
A guest without an account cannot use coupons.

## Definition of Done
- [ ] Acceptance criteria met.
- [ ] Developer testing and sanity check completed.
- [ ] Peer review approved.
- [ ] QA validation approved.
- [ ] Demo completed.
- [ ] Documentation updated, if applicable.
- [ ] Release status and evidence recorded.
